[SWS_SM_00689] ActionListItem - Trigger EnterSuspendState
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00402
⌈
When EnterSuspendToRam
ActionListItem
is triggered,
State Management
shall invoke
ara::sm::s2r::S2RHub::RequestToEnterSuspendMode
and use
maxActionItemDuration
as value for the argument
timeout
. The returned Result
shall be used as the result for the
ActionListItem
.
⌋
